sentences.text: This application has been filed seeking clarification of the order dated 16.02.2024 passed by this Court in the above petition, inasmuch as it fails to mention that FIR was also registered under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Keeping in view the contents of the application, the order dated 16.02.2024 is modified to this extent and paragraph 11 thereof shall now be read as under:-
